# Kovo

> Kovo compiles React-style TSX (function components + hooks) into native Xiaomi Vela QuickApp `.ux` files for Xiaomi/Redmi smartwatches, with zero runtime. It maps React semantics onto the Vela ViewModel (data/protected, computed, $watch, $emit, $element, lifecycles) and enforces the platform's limits (CSS subset, single root, no emoji glyphs, memory guide).

Key facts for generating code: edit only `src-tsx/`; one root element; text only inside `<text>`; no early returns; flexbox only; `.class`/`#id`/`tag` selectors only; no emoji; declare `@system.*` features in `manifest.json`; `<input>` types are only button/checkbox/radio; router params arrive as strings into page state of the same name; a change is done only when `bun run build` shows no `[kovo]` warnings and `bun run aiot:build` succeeds without `🟠` lines.

## Agent guides

- [App guide (AGENTS.md of every scaffolded project)](https://github.com/srsergi0/kovo/blob/main/docs/ai/app-guide.md): rules, supported React subset, unsupported patterns and alternatives, JSX/CSS rules, `@system.*` APIs with manifest features, performance rules, compiler message → fix table
- [Repository guide (AGENTS.md)](https://github.com/srsergi0/kovo/blob/main/AGENTS.md): compiler architecture, change rules, verification for contributors
